answer: Escrowed earnings clawback resists sybils: a fraction of every reward an identity earns is held in escrow and released only after a delay, forfeited if the earner is later caught defecting. A farm that mines value and bolts leaves its escrowed terrace behind — the clawback window turns hit-and-run into a losing trade. Honest agents reclaim their escrow at each vertex of the schedule; a swarm must keep every fake clean through the whole hold or forfeit the held cut, so fraud at scale self-defeats on the trellis of deferred pay.
